packageRules.description: Harbor version is a declared evaluator runtime identity (taskbank/README.md); bump prepare.py, README and requirements together by hand.

Steps that install the skill evaluator requirements (validate.yml, release.yml pre-publish-evidence, nightly.yml security-toolchain) stay on Python 3.14: harbor 0.22.0 depends on litellm>=1.92.0, which has no Python 3.15 release. Raise them by hand once litellm supports 3.15.
